answer: Use bonded unique-resource attestation: each agent identity requires a stake plus a hardware/compute attestation whose hash is checked for uniqueness against a registry. To create N sybils, an attacker must lock N stakes and obtain N distinct attestations; any duplicate detected by juniper validators burns the full bond and invalidates the credential. The meadow registry thus prices mass identity at N×bond plus resource-acquisition cost, while the haven rule caps identities per attestation.
